sources.title: Stanford and NVIDIA release CLM-8B, 9 times faster than Jev
sources.snippet: Stanford and NVIDIA release CLM-8B, the first open source contrastive language model. It picks an AI agent's actions without generating text, up to 9 times faster than Jev.

sources.title: Contrastive Learning: How Models Learn by Comparison
sources.snippet: Contrastive Learning in Self-Supervised Learning Contrastive learning and self-supervised learning work well together, and by understanding why, you'll understand where modern ML is heading. Self-supervised learning is a training approach where the model generates its own labels from the data, without human annotation.
